findings.scope: External identity, coherent route and degree structure
findings.finding: Current OER Appendix 5 confirms four-year ALPO, 120 EC of actual Radboud teaching (34/31/25/30) plus 60 EC recognised from the parallel adapted HAN teacher curriculum. The 180-EC table represents the Radboud BSc, not both degrees. The duplicate PWB3370 is counted once, corroborated by the current fourth-year list. Twenty-six taught components plus the recognition row total 180 unique EC. Select the two Education courses and the accessible Education/Pedagogy professional-skills variant; do not mix specialisations. All formal prerequisites and pre-registration conditions are recorded, with ordinary previous-year completion satisfying progression. RADAr 0 EC remains separate. RU BSA 24/34 and the current HAN nonbinding PSA distinction are retained.

All 38 target-linked rows 1496–1533 have been reconsidered against official RU/HAN identity, four specialisations, specific school subjects and graduate evidence. Fourteen generators are owned by the core or two coherent further candidate directions. Specialisation content is not universal and later adviser/orthopedagogy outcomes require further study. Dutch/music teacher training is an alumnus individual intention. The one developmental psychology, cognition, language and empirical-methods programme materially responds to the defining developmental/learning questions, including actual bounded educational practice in two courses. It remains related study with clear missing pedagogy, education science, sustained didactics/placements and qualification.

findings.scope: Sequential stopping and substantive course contributions
findings.finding: The strongest available clinical/developmental support courses are already included. Extra cellular biology, pathology, infection or lab courses do not create a separate orthopedagogical curriculum. No second qualitatively distinct 24-course programme is supported through padding or reshuffling. Educational evaluation and curriculum design remains a genuine further interest without an adequate dedicated implementation. All 24 selected course profiles/descriptions and their direct/complementary contributions were reread in this final pass. Description-only psycholinguistics receives full weight for language acquisition, bilingualism, reading/dyslexia and experimental approaches; perception/action receives supported neural-mechanism weight without invented child-development content. Clinical/lifespan courses are not specialist professional training; the lifespan interview is with an adult over fifty. The two replacements contribute specific mind/identity and civil-society theory, with no promised school assignments.

findings.scope: Current course reference and complete schedule
findings.finding: The exact current enriched workbook is the sole active reference. All 24 unique selected courses, actual assigned offerings and formal prerequisites were verified; two original offering conflicts were repaired without restoring old offerings. Four courses per term across six terms yield 180 EC, eight advanced courses and Year-1 PPD. Gateway, rhetoric, statistics and life-science dependencies are satisfied, with advisory progression considered separately. Optional independent research 15 EC appears once outside the scheduled programme, beside the required comparator thesis.

All 27 external components and 24 UCR courses occur exactly once. Seven bounded partial relationships and twenty unmatched components retain meaningful differences. Rhetoric in Action has actual age-appropriate lesson/material design with primary schools and therefore supports part of Educational Design, not the 60-EC recognition. Clinical test reliability, validity and appraisal make Psychodiagnostics the stronger partial psychometrics counterpart. Generic ethics, rhetoric and adult perception are not allocated to combined legal/professional ethics, a dedicated pedagogical academic-skills sequence or child motor development. The separate Analyse sequence is not reconstructed from unverified course syllabi. The introductory research note now states empirical design/measurement overlap, explicitly distinguishing UCR statistics from ALPO separate analysis courses; the narrower exact pair is published and mechanically verified.
